composition.value: One axis: frame centre (0.5, 0.5). Every hero object is centred there: the claim, the pill (about 68% width, 13% height), the icon (about 4% width), the disc that grows to fill the frame, the word and stroke, the lit square (22% then 10% of height), the knob and its rings, the reaction bar (about 62% width), the hero word (70% width), the caption, the final mark (about 4% width). Large empty black around small objects: the title and mark leave over 95% of the frame empty. Exceptions: the slider knob starts right of centre (x about 0.6) and is pulled to centre in 13 frames; the message bubble is centred but the flame reaction sits low-left on it. Footage shots are full-frame with subject roughly central, so the fixed caption lands on the subject.

materials.value: Two families. (1) Flat digital: gradient pills, glowing discs, thin white guides and circles, dashed rings, light streaks with bloom, and a halftone or dither dot screen that objects switch to during navy blinks. (2) Found footage: archival photographs and film, thermal-violet false colour, medical scans, a keyboard macro with coloured backlight; each graded differently, overlaid with thin tracking boxes, connector lines and coordinate tags. Frequent one-frame overexposures and RGB-split smears tie the two together as one 'signal' look.

lighting.value: Self-lit objects on black: glows and blooms around the icon, knob and square (glow radius about 1-2x the object), a diagonal lens streak across the square, keyboard backlight dots out of focus behind the mark. No shading on flat elements; no environment.

styleSummary: Black stage, everything at dead centre, small objects in large emptiness; digital UI pieces that glow and turn halftone; one navy ground blink as the house accent; archival footage made to look analysed with tracking boxes and coordinate tags.
